criteria.evidence: walkDestPath Lstat's every component and returns errSymlinkInDest on any symlink; TestScaffoldRefusesASymlinkedDestinationFile / ...ParentDirectory pass.
walkDestPath rejects empty/./.. segments and only creates real directories via os.Mkdir, so the parent path cannot leave destRoot; applyStaged uses makeDestDir.
Turn 0: 'refresh reads remote.origin.url ... compares with SameRepository ... A mismatch ... discards the directory and re-clones'; repointed-origin re-clone test; gitops tests pass.
repo.VerifyPushURL resolves `git remote get-url --push` and Publish/publishScaffold print 'pushing %s to %s'.
hardeningConfig core.hooksPath=/dev/null applied in runRaw when Managed; gitops.Open uses ManagedClient; TestCommitDoesNotRunHooksOnAManagedCheckout.
hardeningEnv sets GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0, GIT_ASKPASS=, SSH_ASKPASS= via EnvRunner for managed invocations.
CommitExactly checks StagedPaths against allowed before Commit and returns UnexpectedPathsError on extras (tolerates subset, disclosed); TestCommitExactlyRefusesAnUnexpectedStagedPath.
CommitExactly re-reads CommitPaths(HEAD) after commit and errors on extras before the caller pushes; TestPublish-level hook tests described and passing.
Turn 1: normalizeURL keeps non-default port; TestSameRepository table covers 8443 vs 9443 differing.
Client.Managed gates hardeningConfig/env; Clone is plain, CloneManaged for cache; only gitops.Open constructs ManagedClient.
TestCommitRunsHooksOnAnUnmanagedCheckout; release/source use unmanaged Client, 'release create ... unaffected'.
VerifyPushURL strips --local remote.origin.pushurl, re-resolves, and hard-fails on any remaining redirect (pushInsteadOf); tests for strip-and-revalidate and fail-closed.
Error guidance: 'an intentional redirect means configuring that repository as the GitOps repo'; mismatch returns an error, no warn-and-continue path.
go vet ./... && go test on deploy, git, gitops, release, source: all 'ok'.
go test ./... produced no failures (filtered output empty); go vet ./... passed implying build succeeds.

judge.reason: The replay implemented symlink-safe scaffold writes with O_NOFOLLOW, origin-URL verification with re-clone, port-preserving identity, managed-only hook hardening, before/after commit path verification, and fail-closed push-destination handling with local pushurl self-heal, all with tests and a green suite. The only soft spot is CommitExactly tolerating fewer-than-expected staged paths rather than strict set equality, which was disclosed and does not weaken the anti-widening guarantee.
